subtitle: A Good Habit

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: D.C. is a popular city for marathons! A marathon is a long race. Many marathons raise money for charity, you know - good works. A marathon is a good fitness goal too. I want to challenge myself in a marathon and maybe win a medal! Hey, there's Ashley. Ashley! Wait for me! It's Anna!
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区很适合跑马拉松！马拉松是一场很长的比赛。很多马拉松是为慈善筹款，也就是做好事。马拉松也是很好的健身目标。我想挑战自己跑一场马拉松，也许还能赢一枚奖牌！嘿，那是阿什莉。阿什莉！等等我！是安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ash ... ley. Ash ... ley.
dialogue.zh: 阿什……莉。阿什……莉。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Are you okay, Anna?
dialogue.zh: 你还好吗，安娜？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I just ran ... from over there.
dialogue.zh: 我刚从那边……跑过来。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Do you want to sit down, Anna? Do you want some water? No thanks. You keep it.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你想坐下吗？要喝点水吗？不用了。你留着吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks. I didn't know you like to run.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我不知道你喜欢跑步。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I love running. In fact, this weekend, I will run in my first marathon.
dialogue.zh: 我爱跑步。其实，这个周末我要跑人生第一场马拉松。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me ... too.
dialogue.zh: 我……也是。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Really? You are running in a marathon?
dialogue.zh: 真的？你也要跑马拉松？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah. In a couple of days. Why do you ask ... like that?
dialogue.zh: 对。过几天。你为什么那样问……？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: What do you know about running in a marathon?
dialogue.zh: 你对跑马拉松了解多少？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know that there's a lot of running and sometimes you can win a medal.
dialogue.zh: 我知道要跑很多路，有时还能赢一枚奖牌。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: How long have you been training?
dialogue.zh: 你训练多久了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I started today. I've been training for an hour ... no, an hour and seven minutes!
dialogue.zh: 我今天才开始。我已经训练一个小时了……不，一个小时零七分钟！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, training a little every day is a good habit to get into. Not all at once!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，每天训练一点点才是好习惯。不要一次全练完！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks for the advice, Ashley. But I'm running in a special race.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你的建议，阿什莉。不过我要跑的是一场特别的比赛。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: What marathon is it?
dialogue.zh: 是哪一场马拉松？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't remember the name. But the website said everyone gets a medal.
dialogue.zh: 我记不得名字了。但网站说每个人都能拿到奖牌。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Okay, well, good luck, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 好吧，祝你好运，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Ashley. Good luck to you, too.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，阿什莉。也祝你好运。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello. I am here to enter the race!
dialogue.zh: 你好。我来报名参赛！

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: But ma'am you can't enter the race.
dialogue.zh: 可是女士，你不能参加这场比赛。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What? How am I going to meet my goal?
dialogue.zh: 什么？那我怎么完成我的目标？

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: Ma'am, this race is for children. You can't run with the children.
dialogue.zh: 女士，这场比赛是给孩子的。你不能和孩子们一起跑。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Children? Children. That's perfect. I just might win!
dialogue.zh: 孩子？孩子。太完美了。我也许能赢！

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: No, ma'am. You really can't run with the children.
dialogue.zh: 不行，女士。你真的不能和孩子们一起跑。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm sorry. Of course. I was only thinking of my goal.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。当然。我只想着自己的目标了。

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: Well, you can help us with our goal, which is to raise money for sick children. Would you like to help us?
dialogue.zh: 那你可以帮我们完成目标，就是为生病的孩子筹款。你愿意帮忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I've just found my new goal. And I get to wear a medal. Good job!
dialogue.zh: 我刚找到了新目标。而且我还能戴奖牌。干得好！

quiz.prompt: What does Ashley say is a good habit?
choices: Running a marathon with no training

quiz.prompt: How long has Anna been training?
choices: For an hour and seven minutes

quiz.prompt: Why can't Anna enter the race?
